page.overview:
What is Unidentified medical frigate?

A medical frigate was attacked by the nascent Alliance to Restore the Republic from the Galactic Empire Though the frigate fell into Rebel possession after the attack, the Empire falsely reported that the ship had remained in their hands.

The medical frigate was mentioned in Leia, Princess of Alderaan, a 2017 young-adult novel written by Claudia Gray.
